solutions: Observe whether the power indicator is steadily on. If it is on, check the LED color. An orange LED indicates that the AC source is connected but the equipment is not started, and a blue LED indicates that the equipment is started. If it is off, check whether the AC source is connected, whether the fuse is intact, and whether the power cable is connected normally without looseness, disconnection, or instability.
Check whether the camera head and CCU are connected normally without looseness or instability, whether the CCU and monitor are connected normally, and whether the monitor input settings are correct.
1. Replacement of the liquid inlet sensor repair spare parts for V1.0 (see 9.11, 9.10 and 9.6), and replacement of liquid inlet contamination repair spare parts for V2.0 (see section 9.11).
2. For V1.0, upgrade the software version to clear the pollution mark (see 10). For V2.0, enter software settings to clear the pollution mark (see 6.5).
